title: Motion-Picture Equipment (35-mm) - Universal Intermittent Sprockets
scope: 1.1 This standard specifies the dimensions of two types of 16-tooth intermittent sprockets for 35-mm motionpicture projectors. Other dimensions and definitions are given in annex A. 1.2 This standard is applicable to sprockets used in conjunction with film perforated in accordance with ANSI/SMPTE 139 (0.1870 in pitch) or SMPTE 102.
